text: やまおくで　しゅぎょう　したのに　…　なさけない
note: Training in the mountains is a real Japanese religious practice: the mountain ascetics called yamabushi, of the Shugendō tradition, go into the mountains to gain spiritual power.
claim: Yamabushi, practitioners of Shugendō, undertake ascetic training in the mountains of Japan.

check.quote: These mountain ascetics (yamabushi, "those who sleep in the mountains" or shugenja, "those who undergo spiritual training") subject themselves to freezing cold and stifling heat, as well as fasting, meditation, and long-distance endurance treks in the wilderness, all to develop spiritual powers and help protect their communities.
check.note: Training in the mountains is a real Japanese religious practice: the mountain ascetics called yamabushi, of the Shugendō tradition, go into the mountains to gain spiritual power.
